messages:
Samir (AE): Hey team, BlueHarbor sent back the SIG (v2024) and we need a question-by-question pass. They care about tenant isolation, kms rotation, and SOC2 artifacts. Can we triage?
Maria (SalesEng): Thanks — attaching their spreadsheet in the thread. Quick ask: they want to know whether Dedicated tenancy + VPC peering is enough for their compliance reviewer.
Aj (Security Eng): Short answer: yes, with Dedicated + VPC + private control plane. But need to provide the network diagram + the Dedicated tenancy doc. I'll prepare a blurb and pointer to artifacts.
Ella (GRC): I'll pull SOC2 type II report and our data flow diagram. For SIG Q12 (encryption at rest) we should reference KMS key rotation policy and HSM note.
Samir (AE): Great. BlueHarbor also asked a pointed question under Q18 about incident response SLA and contact details — they need the oncall rotation doc. Maria, can you confirm whether we can give a named contact or just pager inbox?
Maria (SalesEng): We usually provide the oncall escalation matrix and PS contact for customers on Dedicated enterprise. I'll confirm if they need named individuals — likely not.
Aj (Security Eng): Working on text for these SIG answers. Draft for Q12 (encryption at rest): "All customer data at rest is encrypted using AES-256. Key management is backed by cloud KMS with customer-managed keys available for Private deployments. Keys are rotated automatically every 90 days; manual rotation triggers are logged." Going to attach rotation policy PDF.
Samir (AE): Perfect. Can you also add how we support Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) for Private? They flagged BYOK as a gating item for POC.
Aj (Security Eng): Yup — short BYOK note ready. For POC: for hosted we provide tenant-level encryption with managed keys; for Private/VPC customers we support customer KMS integration (see snippet).
Maria (SalesEng): BlueHarbor asked how enabling SSE (customer keys) impacts pricing/throughput for the POC. Any perf/price delta we should surface?
Aj (Security Eng): Performance impact negligible for metadata; small token-level overhead for envelope encryption. Ops: +5-8% CPU on the encryption path. Pricing: recommend callout that Managed KMS requests are billable by cloud provider; no Redwood surcharge by default.
Ella (GRC): For the SIG items, I'll attach the SOC2 PDF and our AUP summary. Also adding the last penetration test summary (redacted).
Samir (AE): Who will upload the artifacts into the shared folder for BlueHarbor? They asked for a single zip of supporting docs.
Aj (Security Eng): I'll upload: kms-rotation-policy.pdf, byok-integration-guide.pdf, network-diagram-dedicated.svg.
Ella (GRC): I'll upload: SOC2-2024-type2-redacted.pdf, incident-response-matrix.pdf, pentest-summary-redacted.pdf.
Maria (SalesEng): I'll produce the SIG spreadsheet answers (question-by-question) and link back to each artifact in the evidence column. ETA: tomorrow EOD.
POC Bot: Ticket #PR-4921 created to track SIG deliverables and upload checks. ETA reminders set for 24h. :white_check_mark:
Samir (AE): Awesome. One more: Q37 asks about data residency — BlueHarbor wants EU-only. We must state which regions support EU residency and which deployment options. Aj/Ella, can you add a short line?
Aj (Security Eng): Draft: "EU residency supported via Dedicated pools in eu-west-1 and our Private on-prem offering. Hosted API sessions may route to other regions unless tenant pinned — recommend Dedicated for firm EU residency guarantees."
Ella (GRC): Adding the contractual language snippet we use for data residency addendum.
Samir (AE): Cool. I'll message the customer to say we're collating everything and will send the completed SIG + a zip by tomorrow EOD. Anyone blocked?
Maria (SalesEng): None from my side.
Aj (Security Eng): Nothing blocking. I'll finish the KMS artifacts this afternoon.
Ella (GRC): Uploading files now — will ping when done.
POC Bot: Upload check: 3/6 artifacts uploaded. Reminder set for Aj in 6h.
Samir (AE): Thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source for the SIG Q&A. If BlueHarbor follows up on canary rollouts or fallback policies, tag me and I will coordinate the technical demo. :thumbsup:
